edits.old: And the browser calls one composite route per screen and no owner service directly
edits.new:
And the browser calls one composite route per screen and no owner service directly

  Scenario: AC11 Empty, error and no-access states on SCR-02 and SCR-04 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the case owner holds the Case record right with scope "Own"
    When the case owner opens SCR-02 Case list with no case in scope
    Then the screen shows the empty state with text "Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P3-E2001-APP-10)"
    When the gateway-bff composite route for SCR-04 cannot reach rwb-integration
    Then the screen shows message MSG-GEN-006 with {system} "rwb-integration"
    When "U-5001" holding RW-REFADM opens SCR-04 Case timeline
    Then the screen shows message MSG-P4-002 and no timeline

  Scenario: AC12 Case number format and no reuse (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case sequence has issued "RW-2026-000123"
    When the entry step creates the next case
    Then the case number is RW-YYYY-NNNNNN taken from the rwb-case sequence
    Then no case number already issued is assigned again

  Scenario: AC13 Threshold, product map and action codes are parameters (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given parameter "case.entry.dpd_threshold" is 90
    When a new version of parameter "case.entry.dpd_threshold" is in effect and the entry step runs
    Then the entry follows the parameter version in effect
    Then no code change is needed for the threshold, the product map, the action codes or the cut-off

  Scenario: AC14 rwb-case holds no foreign key into another schema (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb_case schema is deployed
    When the schema is checked
    Then no foreign key references another schema
    Then the case link is a business key of 255 characters

  Scenario: AC15 CaseCreated is written in the case transaction (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the entry step creates a case for "A-0001"
    When the transaction commits
    Then the CaseCreated event is in the outbox row of that transaction
    Then the event is relayed with the CloudEvents envelope
